record.final_answer:
The total shipping cost for October is **58.01**, across 6 orders:

| Order | Zone | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| A-1001 | north | 6.94 |
| A-1002 | south | 6.28 |
| A-1003 | island | 15.25 |
| A-1004 | north | 15.10 |
| A-1005 | south | 9.03 |
| A-1006 | north | 5.41 |

Running the script as-is failed with `no rate for zone "north"`, even though north is listed in the rates file. The cause is that `data/zone-rates.tsv` has Windows line endings, so the script reads each zone name with a hidden carriage return on the end and none of them match.

To get around it without editing anything, I made a temporary copy of the rates file with those characters removed and passed it as the script's optional second argument. The temporary copy is deleted, and the script and both data files are unchanged.

Converting `zone-rates.tsv` to Unix line endings would fix this for good, but that's your call since you asked me to leave it alone. I also saved this workaround to memory so future sessions know about it.
